title: AssureCode: Structured Justification for Trustworthy Agentic Coding
abstract: arXiv:2610.29758v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The use of AI-based tools in software development is rapidly changing how software is produced, enabling large volumes of code to be generated with limited human implementation effort. However, this raises fundamental challenges for ensuring that generated artifacts are aligned with developer intent and have been appropriately validated. In this work, we propose the use of structured argumentation in driving AI-assisted software development. Inspired by techniques from assurance engineering for safety-critical systems, we define a language of justification rationales that explicitly relate informal natural language prompts, formal specifications, assumptions about developer intentions, and program analysis evidence in a structured and verifiable format. translated_title: AssureCode：面向可信智能体编程的结构化论证
translated_abstract: 在软件开发中使用基于AI的工具正在迅速改变软件的生产方式，使得在有限的人工实现工作量下能够生成大量代码。然而，这给确保生成的代码制品符合开发者意图并经过适当验证带来了根本性挑战。在本工作中，我们提出使用结构化论证来驱动AI辅助的软件开发。受安全关键系统保证工程技术的启发，我们定义了一种论证理由语言，该语言以结构化且可验证的格式，显式关联非正式的自然语言提示、形式化规范、关于开发者意图的假设以及程序分析证据。随后，我们介绍了AssureCode，这是一种由工具支持的方法论，用于在智能体代码生成过程中创建此类论证理由。我们对所实现系统进行了实证分析……
tldr: 该论文借鉴安全关键系统的保证工程技术，提出AssureCode方法论，通过结构化论证将自然语言提示、形式化规范、开发者意图假设与程序分析证据关联起来，从而提升AI智能体生成代码的可信度与可验证性。
